{{Top|leg}}
The '''MM-9''' portable [[Missile/Legends|missile]] was produced after the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] for use in [[Backpack/Legends|backpack]] and shoulder mounted [[Projectile cannon|projectile launchers]]. The missile was expensive and highly destructive, which served to limit its use.
